spec.history_scope: prior interactions from the official training split for this user and candidate tab
spec.time_order: strictly earlier interaction time than the current row ordered by time_ms
spec.formula: (prior long_view positives for the user-candidate-tab pair + 20 * global training long_view rate) / (prior tab interactions + 20)
spec.rationale: Measures historical engagement by recommendation context.

spec.rationale: Captures preference for the candidate duration profile.
